verdict.rationale: Orb documents a real-time webhooks system that fires on events, plus dunning retries (payment failure), plan-change audit trails, and cancellation-adjacent proration/invoice logic, indicating lifecycle events are covered. However, there's no explicit enumeration of which specific lifecycle events (renewal, upgrade, cancellation) trigger webhooks, nor evidence of delivery guarantees (retries, signing, at-least-once semantics) for the webhook system itself. missing for 10: explicit list of webhook event types covering renewal/upgrade/cancellation, delivery reliability guarantees (retries/dedup) for webhooks specifically, independent confirmation of webhook reliability in production.
